body:
Closes #436. Owner acceptance on #276/#325 remains separate.

The installer previously wrote final files before validating all inputs; `-NoShortcuts` skipped validation, and a source PWA shortcut could be overwritten through a path alias. The installer now validates and stages the complete candidate before publication, refuses physical source/output collisions, gives actionable supported-Node guidance, and restores verified originals after publication failure. Uncertain recovery artifacts are retained for diagnosis.

Private `--validate-install` and `--stage-shortcut` commands require fully qualified Windows paths and run before launcher side effects. Staged shortcuts contain their final target, config, icon and AppUserModelID. Public PowerShell relative-path behavior is preserved. The change adds bounded child calls, same-volume staging, file-identity checks and permanent Windows PowerShell 5.1 regressions.

Final publication head: `2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c`; target: `be633141be5a0cd2b4f960a46761fabbf2cb82c7`. The six product/test/document inputs are unchanged from corrected product `a73b9a887c50f51d4fc4af54aa806fda42e31abf`. The temporary QA workflow has been removed; the ordinary workflow is byte-identical to the target. [Final ordinary CI run](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43829142179) passed all four jobs on attempt 1 against verified synthetic merge `80c581ebc95de2000c25ed2b5995d5a648fa95ba`, tree `d064706fb48def7bacac5e434f96825c5850d214`.

Validation:

- [Old-source baseline](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c/docs/qa/2026-11-16-installer-validation-baseline/README.md): 32 cases reproduced 22 differences, including 17 invalid-input final-file mutations and eight invalid successes.
- [Focused implementation checks](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c/docs/qa/2026-11-16-installer-validation-implementation/README.md) and [independent actual Opus behavior QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c/docs/qa/2026-11-16-installer-private-cli-corrected/README.md): the private-path correction passed 29 cases and 384 checks, with all actual child exit/close receipts retained. Inert executable fixtures provide component evidence.
- [First hosted candidate](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c/docs/qa/2026-11-16-installer-validation-candidate-first-failure/README.md): 31/32 criteria passed; omitted Node discovery under caller StrictMode returned a raw property error. The [narrow correction and permanent regression](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c/docs/qa/2026-11-16-installer-node-discovery-correction/README.md) preserve that failure and now cover missing and valid default discovery.
- [Corrected hosted QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c/docs/qa/2026-11-16-installer-validation-candidate-corrected/README.md): all 32 cases passed (four supported routes, 28 refusals), with unchanged refused bytes/native identities. All 49 direct process receipts and 399 traced lifetimes matched; no gateway/Chrome start or trace loss was observed. A separate actual PowerShell 5.1 public seed and composed production publisher recorded three real replacements followed by Windows sharing error `0x80070020`, then restored all six original artifacts and native metadata. Root independently verified both ZIPs, every member and the raw lifetime analysis.
- [First carrier CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c/docs/qa/2026-11-16-installer-candidate-other-ci/README.md) and [corrected carrier CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/2732dd34457bcd9a7007e89c3fa11fe085af764c/docs/qa/2026-11-16-installer-corrected-other-ci/README.md) preserve the Gates 30-minute deadline failures. Browser and Template image passed both; final licence/docs/contrast/audit checks were skipped. The corrected attempt emitted only ten of thirteen coverage groups. These attempts do not satisfy the final CI gate.

Qualifications: matrix PowerShell 7 versus the permanent/public-seed PowerShell 5.1 checks; real image Chrome proxy with synthetic profile; composed rollback rather than timed public-installer interruption; no owner UI acceptance. The initial offline count of 396 lifetimes and its birth-bounded correction to 399 are both retained, with the PartitionInfo decode warning. No native rerun was needed for that offline correction. Prior unrelated native refusal and coverage-deadline findings remain #471/#488.

Delivery: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh implementation, narrow GPT-6 Luna xhigh corrections, separate GPT-6.1 Sol native QA and actual Claude Code Opus 5.5 xhigh behavior QA. Final CI passed Gates (9,619 passed/41 skipped; all 13 coverage groups above both floors), Browser (481 passed/one declared live-provider skip, zero retries), Windows (18/18) and Template image. Root independently verified the coverage archive/member hashes and terminal logs. The Windows upload found no artifact; Browser strict performance was off. [Actual Claude Code Opus 5.5 xhigh formal review](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/497#issuecomment-6912181315) returned READY; runtime model/effort and exit were verified. R1 is parked in #498, unverified cloud-placeholder compatibility U1 in #499, and missing CI artifacts O1 duplicates #496. Current acceptance does not establish cloud-provider or ReFS behavior. Root corrected the report's Gates step count to 32. A fresh Astra max exact-head/target audit is running. Formal scans: 2/3, scan 2 running. The draft remains unmerged; held PR #460 and subsequent #438/#456 retain their gates.
